blockers.description: Windows host C: drive was down to 343MB-1.1GB free during this session. Docker Desktop's docker_data.vhdx (dynamically-expanding, 88GB on disk) does not shrink when Docker-internal data (images/volumes/build cache/per-node containerd caches) is deleted — internal cleanup does not free host disk. User is running wsl --shutdown + Optimize-VHD/diskpart compact from an admin Windows PowerShell to reclaim real host space before resuming.
blockers.workaround: Verify `df -h /mnt/c` (or Windows drive free space) shows meaningful headroom (several GB+) BEFORE dispatching wave 6 (09-11) — do not trust `docker system df` alone, it only reports Docker-internal usage, not host disk.

human_actions_pending.context: Reclaim real C: drive space before wave 6's heavy live 2-year backfill sweep runs, to avoid ENOSPC failures mid-test

decisions.decision: Removed the entire unrelated 'Divio' Docker project (15 containers, 4 images, 7 volumes, 1 network) from this host
decisions.rationale: User explicitly requested removal; confirmed unrelated to airflow-platform and volumes held only ~187MB of real data

decisions.decision: Pruned stale csv-processor/dbt/airflow git-sha-tagged images from local Docker cache, the local registry mirror, and both kind worker nodes' containerd caches, keeping only the currently-deployed tags (csv-processor:ee240ba, dbt:faa7533, airflow:cd0d2aa)
decisions.rationale: Project's Makefile image-* targets intentionally never prune old immutable git-sha tags (by design, for traceability per CLAUDE.md §77/§62) but nothing else does either, so ~19 stale csv-processor builds had accumulated across 3 storage locations

decisions.decision: Did NOT enable delete+GC on the local kind-registry container in this session
decisions.rationale: Requires a container restart (REGISTRY_STORAGE_DELETE_ENABLED=true) which was deprioritized once it became clear internal Docker cleanup wasn't fixing the actual host-disk blocker

decisions.decision: LOAD-06 requirement is NOT marked complete for this phase

next_action: Once host disk headroom is confirmed real (not just Docker-internal), run /gsd:execute-phase 09 — it will detect the 10 completed plans (09-01 through 09-10, all merged to main with passing post-merge test gates) via their SUMMARY.md files and dispatch Wave 6 (09-11), the live 2-year backfill sweep capstone test.
context_notes: Phase 09 wave-based execution (6 waves, 11 plans) was proceeding cleanly through Wave 5 when the host Windows C: drive hit critical disk pressure (Docker daemon actually went down once mid-session from disk exhaustion, recovered after user restarted Docker Desktop). Extensive investigation confirmed the root cause is Docker Desktop's dynamically-expanding docker_data.vhdx never shrinking on internal deletion — only a host-side VHDX compact (wsl --shutdown + Optimize-VHD) actually returns space to C:. Real waste was found and removed (~45GB: an unrelated Divio project stack, stale build history, unused build cache) but ~30-35GB of remaining Docker usage is legitimate infrastructure for the mandated 3-node kind cluster (each worker node independently caches every workload image via containerd, no cross-node dedup) plus live CNPG/MinIO/Vault volumes. Wave 6 (09-11) was deliberately NOT dispatched given the disk risk — it's the heaviest remaining plan (live 2-year corpus, concurrent DagRuns, real MinIO uploads) and a mid-run ENOSPC failure would be both misleading and expensive to diagnose. Do not re-run the Docker-internal cleanup steps expecting further host-disk gains — that lever is exhausted; only the VHDX compact moves the needle further.
